meta.title: Solar Engineer
meta.tagline: Design solar energy systems that harness the sun's power.
meta.description: Solar engineers specialize in photovoltaic and solar thermal system design — from rooftop installations to utility-scale solar farms.

details.description: Solar engineers specialize in photovoltaic and solar thermal system design — from rooftop installations to utility-scale solar farms.
details.whyLearn: Design solar energy systems that harness the sun's power. Solar engineers specialize in photovoltaic and solar thermal system design — from rooftop installations to utility-scale solar farms.
objectives: Build a complete foundation in solar engineer
Complete hands-on projects for your portfolio
interviewQuestions: Why do you want to become a solar engineer?
Walk me through a project you're proud of
How do you keep your skills up to date?
details.careerRelevance: Solar Engineer is a High demand career with typical salaries of $65k-$120k+.
tips: Follow this roadmap in order
Build and publish projects at every stage
Join communities and network
